    Profile

    An incarnation of Othima who has fallen to the Darkness, divested of the hopes he held during his lifetime. He carries within him the sin of greed. It has altered his sound judgement, which had relied upon his ability to be tolerant and conciliatory, so that he approaches everything from a self-serving perspective and would not hesitate to eliminate another to realize his own desires.
